name: Easy Tide
strap: Bring the team into the flow.
headline:
All together.
A little easier.
summary: Playful, expressive and full of character. Bold teal and coral, flowing forms and a sociable octopus make an approachable identity with plenty of illustration potential.
audience: Friendly, collaborative teams that want their tools to have personality.
mascotDescription: A teal octopus with curling arms and a coral conversation bubble. Ocho brings scattered conversations together and can support reactions, stickers and welcome states.
logoIdea: A rounded bubble crest above four flowing arms. It reduces Ocho's shape into a simple wave-and-conversation symbol rather than a detailed animal portrait.
illustrationIdea: Broad wave ribbons form a circular current as Ocho gently gathers coral chat bubbles into one shared flow.
style: Bold rounded ink contours, broad teal ribbons and light risograph grain. Keep artwork spacious and limit decorative shapes around product UI.
recommendation: Most expressive mascot system and best potential for stickers and community personality.
tradeoff: Keep the octopus in onboarding and marketing so the everyday workspace remains focused.
